question: Who inaugurated the Sharadchandra Pawar Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence in Baramati and described NCP (SP) chief Sharad Pawar as his mentor?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gautam Adani.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Industrialist Gautam Adani inaugurated the Sharadchandra Pawar Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence in Baramati and called Sharad Pawar his mentor.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Sharadchandra Pawar Centre of Excellence in Artificial Intelligence was inaugurated in Baramati.**
 
• The centre has been funded by the Adani Group and established under Vidya Pratishthan, run by the Pawar family.
 
• Gautam Adani publicly acknowledged Sharad Pawar as his mentor, citing a relationship spanning over three decades.
 
• The initiative aims to promote applied research and integrated development in artificial intelligence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Sharadchandra Pawar Centre of Excellence in AI__

 __
 
• Established to advance research, engineering and application of artificial intelligence.
 
• Envisioned as a hub for innovation and technological capability building.
 
• Located in Baramati, Maharashtra.
 
 
 
• Vidya Pratishthan__
 __
 
• An educational trust run by the Pawar family.
 
• Plays a key role in educational and skill development initiatives in Baramati.
 
• Hosts multiple institutions focused on higher education and technology.
 
 
 
• Political Context__
 
 
• Leaders from the Pawar family praised Adani’s contributions during the event.
 
• The Opposition Maha Vikas Aghadi alleged Adani’s role in the NCP split.
 
• The event sparked political debate alongside its technological focus.
